title: Upgrade LLM model from 3B to 7B+ parameters
description:
## Problem
Intent parsing reliability is the #1 runtime issue. The current ollama 3B model frequently produces low-confidence or incorrect intent classifications, causing the agent to ask unnecessary clarification questions or misinterpret commands entirely.

## Evidence
- Multiple audit findings (Sprint 41+, internal-audit-57)
- Roadmap Gap Analysis — most impactful performance improvement available
- LLM evaluator fast-path (TSK-0320) partially mitigates but doesn't address model quality

## Scope
1. Evaluate available 7B+ models compatible with ollama (e.g., Mistral 7B, Llama 3 8B, Qwen 2.5 7B)
2. Update OllamaProvider configuration in appsettings.json
3. Update num_predict and timeout settings for larger model
4. Benchmark intent parsing accuracy vs 3B model
5. Update documentation (README, architecture.md) with model requirements

## Files
- Agent.Personality/LlmChatInterpreter.cs — primary consumer
- Agent.Core/Runtime/OllamaProvider.cs — model configuration
- Configuration files (appsettings.json)

## Validation
- 10+ test chat commands with known intents
- Verify confidence scores consistently above 0.7
- Verify no regression in response latency
